C0429.title: Xiangtan Police Dismantle Cyber-Enabled Mafia-Like Groups Extorting via Negative Public Opinion
C0429.summary: In September 2023, during the 'Summer Action' campaign, Xiangtan police dismantled a cyber-enabled mafia-like group led by Pan and another led by Zhang for extortion through negative public opinion and malicious complaints, arresting 13 suspects and solving 18 cases, effectively curbing the spread of organized crime into cyberspace.
